kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتكهرب (form IIq)
# أَتَكَهْرَبُ (ʔatakahrabu) /ʔa.ta.kah.ra.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَكَهْرَبَ (takahraba)
# أَتَكَهْرَبَ (ʔatakahraba) /ʔa.ta.kah.ra.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَكَهْرَبَ (takahraba)
# أَتَكَهْرَبْ (ʔatakahrab) /ʔa.ta.kah.rab/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَكَهْرَبَ (takahraba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
